name: @tradrl/outcomes
description: Outcome/post-mortem learning contracts (Work Order T033): the OutcomeRecord (a decision linked to its realized consequences with full L9/L15 lineage refs — trajectory, experiment, shadow session, decision stream position), the PostMortemRecord (structured post-mortem: what was expected, what happened, attribution hypotheses with confidence, evidence refs), the closed outcome-class vocabulary, the four typed attribution classes, the append-only chain-verified learning logs (T030's fold law, mirrored), and the evaluation-hook shapes T035 will consume to drive autonomous improvement.
